“So, I put these out there for you to reflect on when you are encountering your realities, and not for you to blindly follow.”
所以，我把这些拿出来，是供你在遭遇自己的现实时反思，而不是让你盲目照做。

“most people are reluctant to point out mistakes in others. As a result, an objective diagnosis of problems arising from people’s mistakes is often missing and personal evolution is stunted.”
多数人不愿指出别人的错误。结果，对人的错误引起的问题，常常缺少客观的诊断，个人的进化也受到阻碍。
Ray Dalio, Principles, PDF © 2011（2016 重排版）, p. 33
“too much pain can break someone and that the absence of pain typically prevents growth”
过多的痛苦会把人压垮，而没有痛苦通常会妨碍成长

“‘I can’t get enough sleep’ is not a problem, it is a cause of some problem.”
“我睡不够”不是问题，它是某个问题的原因。
Ray Dalio, Principles, PDF © 2011（2016 重排版）, p. 32

“It is a very common mistake for people to move directly from identifying a tough problem to a proposed solution in a nanosecond without spending the hours required to properly diagnose and design a solution.”
人们很常犯的一个错误，是认出一个难题之后，一眨眼就直接跳到一个解决方案上，而不花上必要的几个小时，好好诊断问题、设计解决方案。
Ray Dalio, Principles, PDF © 2011（2016 重排版）, p. 32
Ray Dalio, Principles, PDF © 2011（2016 重排版）, #30, #31
分歧中的意见 · 权重不同
分歧中的意见 · 权重不同

“By believability, I mean the probability that a person’s view will be right. While we can never know this precisely, we can roughly assess it according to the quality of a person’s reasoning and their track record.”
我说的可信度，是指一个人的看法正确的概率。我们永远无法精确知道它，但可以根据一个人推理的质量和他过往的记录，粗略地评估它。
Ray Dalio, Principles, PDF © 2011（2016 重排版）, #31b
“At the same time, people’s ideas should always be assessed on their merit in order to encourage them to always think in an open-minded way.”
与此同时，人们的想法始终应当按其本身的是非来评估，以鼓励他们始终以开放的心态思考。
新手 · 有时也有很好的想法
“Never make any important decisions without asking at least three believable people.”
没有问过至少三位可信的人，绝不做任何重要的决定。
Ray Dalio, Principles, PDF © 2011（2016 重排版）, #195b
Ray Dalio, Principles, PDF © 2011（2016 重排版）, #24
“Create a Culture in Which It Is OK to Make Mistakes but Unacceptable Not to Identify, Analyze, and Learn From Them”
建立这样一种文化：犯错没关系，但不识别、不分析、不从中学习，是不可接受的
Ray Dalio, Principles, PDF © 2011（2016 重排版）, #8

“the diagnosis must connect the mistake to the specific individual by name.”
诊断必须把错误连到具体的个人，并点出名字。

“I also believe that to allow opt-outs would legitimatize two sets of rules and put our radically honest way of being in jeopardy.”
我还认为，允许有人退出，就会让两套规则都名正言顺，并危及我们彻底坦诚的处事方式。
“Second, this theory has been tested over the last 40 years and has worked.”
其次，这套理论在过去四十年里经过了检验，而且行之有效。

我们有、也应该有一套明确的决策层级，最好以才干为基础。
